name: Michigan City
source_note: City of Michigan City MichiganCityWards FeatureServer, one layer per ward (layers 0-5, Name 'Ward 1'..'Ward 6'); data last edited 2023-01-03, matching the city's 'Wards, 2023' PDF. The city calls its districts wards.

name: Greensburg
source_note: City of Greensburg 'Greensburg City Council Map' (ArcGIS web map a3ed8b97eda2499d8b4b531706dcae3e), one view layer per district (Voting_District_1..4_view); district populations sum to 12,343 against the 2020 census; edited Jan 2026.
bound_reason: Greensburg's district polygons reach 7.17% beyond TIGER's 2024 place polygon: the city's own limits run ahead of TIGER (annexations). Clipped to TIGER so the council seats match the citywide seats; the district populations still sum to the 2020 census count.

name: Jasper
source_note: City of Jasper Boundaries FeatureServer layer 12 City_Council_Disctricts: precinct-level rows dissolved by district; Jasper numbers its five districts 2-6 (council page). Rows first edited Jan 2023, after the 2022 redraw.

name: New Haven
source_note: City of New Haven City_Council_Districts MapServer 0 (5 features, DISTRICT 1-5); features created 2025-03-20 by the city's GIS; MEMBER names match the council page.

name: Warsaw
source_note: City of Warsaw Council_2022 MapServer 1 (cityofwarsaw_sde.DBO.Council_2022_PostRedistricting): 2020 census blocks tagged with their council district, dissolved here by District.
bound_reason: Warsaw's districts are 2020 census blocks (district populations 3,065-3,269, total 15,829 against the 2020 census count of 15,804, so this is the post-2020 map). 7.25% of TIGER's 2024 place has no district: land annexed since the blocks were tagged, whose District field is 0. Residents there see the citywide seats only until the city assigns the land to a district.

source_note: City of Bluffton City_Council_Districts FeatureServer 49 (web map created 2024-02-27, edited 2026-11-19); the city noticed a 2022 redistricting into five single-member districts for the 2023 election.
